title: British Army Role Fitness Test (Soldier), Ground Close Combat
creator: British Army
description: The in-service test for infantry and armoured-corps soldiers introduced in 2019: a 4 km march with 40 kg in 50 minutes, then 2 km with 25 kg in 15 minutes, followed by fire-and-movement bounds with a crawl and sprint, a 110 kg casualty drag, a carry of two 22 kg water cans, a 70 kg vehicle casevac lift and a repeated lift-and-carry of 20 kg bags. Paras and 16 Air Assault get 35 and 12:30 minutes for the marches. Distances for the drag, carries and lift are not in the public description, so treat those as one effort each.

source.title: All You Need To Know About The British Army's Fitness Standards – Forces News, 24 Oct 2019
source.author: British Army (via Forces News)
